title: bootBuildImage push to Google Artifact Registry fails with 'docker-credential-gcloud' error on Windows
errorSample:
java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "docker-credential-gcloud": CreateProcess error=2, The system cannot find the file specified
	at java.base/java.lang.ProcessBuilder.start(ProcessBuilder.java:1112)
	at java.base/java.lang.ProcessBuilder.start(ProcessBuilder.java:1046)
	at org.gradle.internal.classpath.Instrumented.start(Instrumented.java:315)
	at org.springframework.boot.buildpack.platform.docker.configuration.CredentialHelper.start(CredentialHelper.java:88)
	at org.springframework.boot.buildpack.platform.docker.configuration.CredentialHelper.get(CredentialHelper.java:54)
	at org.springframework.boot.buildpack.platform.docker.configuration.DockerRegistryConfigAuthentication.computeCredentialsFromHelper(DockerRegistryConfigAuthentication.java:129)
symptom: Pushing with bootBuildImage fails when the plugin tries to read credentials through docker-credential-gcloud: IOException Cannot run program "docker-credential-gcloud", CreateProcess error=2.
cause: The gcloud credential helper is invoked successfully but the stored access token has expired or the account lacks the Artifact Registry writer role, so the helper exits with a failure that the plugin reports as a missing program. The registry then rejects the unauthenticated push.
fixSummary: Refresh the login with gcloud auth login, re-run gcloud auth configure-docker for the registry host, and grant the pushing account the Artifact Registry Writer role in the project. Retry the push after the token has been renewed.
